note: P-SWAP (arrangement-native swap/move v1) — the CONTENTS-only binding exchange. Scene: a v-line at x=500 splits the 1000x800 canvas into two LEAF cells 1:0:0 (w201) and 1:1:0 (w202). swap(1:0:0; 1:1:0) trades the two bindings: 1:0:0 now holds w202, 1:1:0 holds w201 (windows trade cells). ASSERTS the load-bearing swap invariants: .segments BYTE-IDENTICAL (segments_byte_eq — the partition is untouched, the #1 golden-equiv hazard avoided by construction); .promotions byte-equal; contents[0].window_id == window_id for every cell (cell_consistent — what wm_parcel_arrangement_set gates at store.sh:136); valid_rec is INVARIANT (valid_rec_eq_before — it reads .segments/.nested only, never .contents). Each window inherits the OTHER cell's frame on the next settle's re-stamp; the swap itself keeps each cell's geometry (frame stays with the cell).
